The brinewrack cutthroat makes two cutlass attacks.

The cairnback brute makes two greatclub attacks.

name: Brightwing Sentinel

entries.prose: The brightwing sentinel makes two radiant spear attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

spellcasting: The sentinel's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components. At will: light, thaumaturgy. 1/day each: lesser restoration, protection from evil and good.

entries.prose: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
The ooze regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn.
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.
A creature that touches the emberwhirl or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d4 + 1) fire damage.
The emberwhirl makes two fiery lash attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) fire damage.
Each creature in a 10-foot radius must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Voidbloom Seer

entries.prose: The voidbloom seer makes two mind lash attacks.
Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) psychic damage.
Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting: The seer's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components. At will: detect thoughts, mage hand. 1/day: confusion.
legendary_intro: The voidbloom seer can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The voidbloom seer regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

entries.prose: The leviathan can burrow through sand and loose earth without disturbing the ground, leaving no tunnel behind.
The dune leviathan makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) piercing damage.
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

name: Hollowvale Hexer

Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) force damage.

spellcasting: The hexer is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). Cantrips (at will): minor illusion, poison spray. 1st level (4 slots): charm person, ray of sickness. 2nd level (3 slots): hold person, misty step.
